nodes.title: 1. Your data
nodes.statementTemplate: Only the text or rows you select for a task leave your browser. Background tabs and unselected drafts stay on your machine.
nodes.detail: You can inspect the exact payload in the browser network tab before pressing Run. No background telemetry reads document bodies.

nodes.title: 2. In transit
nodes.statementTemplate: Sent over HTTPS (TLS 1.3) directly to our worker in {location}.
nodes.detail: Connections terminate at the regional gateway you choose in workspace settings. Payloads are not routed through third-party analytics proxies.

nodes.title: 3. Processing
nodes.statementTemplate: Processed in {location} to extract steps and source links. Your inputs are not used to train shared models.
nodes.detail: Model inference runs under a zero-training agreement with our inference host. Memory buffers are cleared when the response stream closes.

nodes.title: 4. Storage
nodes.statementTemplate: Saved in {location} for {retentionDays} days so your team can reopen the notebook and check its sources.
nodes.detail: Workspace admins can lower the retention window to 7 days or 0 days (stateless mode) from the Data Settings page.

nodes.title: 5. Deletion
nodes.statementTemplate: Deleted automatically after {retentionDays} days, or within 24 hours whenever you click Delete run.
nodes.detail: Encrypted database backups roll off after 7 additional days. Exporting or deleting your workspace takes two clicks and needs no support ticket.

subprocessors.name: Basin Database Hosting
subprocessors.purpose: Encrypted PostgreSQL storage for saved notebook runs
